Cómo nos cuidamos al aprender y construi: How we look after one another while learning and building with IGUA.DEV, from Puerto Iguazú to the world.
A space we look after together.
Estas reglas acompañan nuestra forma de: These guidelines support how we learn, share, and collaborate. Everyone participating in IGUA.DEV is expected to follow them, in person and online.
IGUA.DEV nace en Puerto Iguazú, Misiones: IGUA.DEV started in Puerto Iguazú, Misiones, to bring people closer to technology. You do not need to live here, have experience, or use a particular tool to participate. Different countries, languages, cultures, and skills are part of the community we want to build.
El reglamento alcanza a integrantes, org: These guidelines apply to members, organizers, speakers, mentors, collaborators, sponsors, and guests in official activities and channels, and in private contact related to the community.
Explicá sin descalificar. Dales lugar a: Explain without belittling. Make room for beginners’ questions and give feedback on the work without attacking the person. Do not mock accents, languages, or difficulties expressing an idea.
Pedí permiso antes de ayudar sobre un di: Ask before helping on someone else’s device or repository. Credit contributions, respect licenses, and share resources in ways that help others learn.
No se permiten discriminación, humillaci: Discrimination, humiliation, harassment, threats, intimidation, and sexual content intended to make others uncomfortable are not allowed. This includes attacks based on origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, appearance, or financial circumstances.
Respetá los límites: no insistas con men: Respect boundaries: do not persist with messages, physical contact, or invitations after someone declines. Deliberate disruption, impersonation, scams, malicious links, and retaliation against someone raising a concern are also unacceptable.
Antes de publicar fotos, grabaciones, ca: Ask the people involved before publishing photos, recordings, screenshots, or conversations. Do not share personal data, credentials, or private project information. A public activity does not give permission to expose its participants.
En los eventos, respetá las indicaciones: At events, follow photography instructions and respect anyone who does not want to appear. Our privacy policy explains how the website handles personal data.
Las preguntas, recursos y proyectos son: Questions, resources, and projects are welcome in the appropriate space. Avoid spam, repeated posts, and mass private messages. Disclose any commercial interest when recommending a product or service.
Coordiná con la administración antes de: Coordinate with administrators before posting promotions, job openings, external calls, or announcements on behalf of IGUA.DEV. A collaboration or shared link does not imply official endorsement.
Cómo pedir ayuda o reportar: Getting help or reporting a concern
Si algo ocurre durante un encuentro, bus: If something happens during a meetup, approach the organizer identified on its event page or the team responsible at the venue. You can ask to speak privately and share only what you feel able to. You do not need to confront the other person.
Para situaciones en línea, usá el contac: For online incidents, use the private moderation contact announced by the organizers in that channel. If you can, explain what happened, where, when, and what support you need. Keep evidence private; do not post the people involved’s personal details in the group.
El canal específico de reportes todavía: A dedicated reporting channel is not yet available on this website. This page does not receive incident reports or provide emergency assistance. In immediate danger, prioritize getting away from the situation and seeking local help.
La organización buscará escuchar a las p: Organizers will seek to hear from the people involved and limit information sharing to those who need to respond. They cannot promise absolute confidentiality or response times that have not been established.
Según la gravedad y el contexto, podrá p: Depending on severity and context, organizers may ask for conduct to stop, remove content, issue a warning, restrict access, or exclude someone temporarily or permanently. A serious situation may require immediate action without a prior warning.
Si una medida te involucra, podés solici: If a measure concerns you, you can request a review through the organizers’ private contact. If your concern involves an organizer, approach another team member where possible.
La organización podrá actualizar estas r: Organizers may update these guidelines and will identify the current version here. Suggestions can be shared with the people organizing activities. Looking after the community includes reviewing how we do it.
Redacción propia para la realidad y los: Written for IGUA.DEV’s circumstances and currently available channels.
